programmes.d: Trina's first date since filing for divorce; Toni gets ready for the Grammys; Tamar feels distant from her sisters.

When the sisters hear concerning rumors before Trina's Pop-Up Bar Chix event, they confront Trina; Trina reveals the truth about a shocking arrest at her home; tempers flare in Towanda's custody battle.
The sisters bond over bowling, but Trina gets defensive about her divorce; Tamar works on new music for her next album.

Tamar's new single sparks drama when Mommy is shocked to find out it's written about her and Daddy's divorce; the gloves come off in Towanda's custody battle; Traci does a photoshoot for her whiskey line.
Traci's behavior concerns family in Miami; Tamar judges on "RuPaul's Drag Race"; sisters panic on an alligator tour.
The Braxtons arrive in Puerto Vallarta, Mexico for their family trip without Daddy; while the sisters are having fun, surprise guests threaten to ruin the vacation.
Tamar misses an important family event and defends herself; a major blow-up splits the family; counseling session.

Daddy brings his wife to Mexico, stunning Miss Evelyn and the girls; all hell breaks loose when Toni invites Daddy and his wife to dinner; after years of misconceptions, the girls learn the shocking truth.
The sisters get harsh criticism from Bishop T.D. Jakes; Daddy surprises everyone with an RV trip to an amusement park.

The sisters try to move forward after their dramatic dinner with Daddy; Tamar tries to clear the air with Daddy, but isn't ready to invite his wife to Vince's birthday party; the sisters also bail on the party.
Trina faces final divorce decisions and stresses over Bar Chix; the sisters grill Trina's new man, Jacent.
Toni discovers a scary new Lupus symptom that could change her life forever; Towanda reveals shocking news about her divorce; Mommy finally opens up about Daddy and the Mexico trip.

Traci confronts the sisters; Tamar promotes her spring fashion line in NYC; Trina recruits bartenders; Toni invites Traci to sing during her show at a major jazz festival; Traci is overwhelmed at sound check.
The Braxtons are stunned by news of Tamar's divorce filing; Traci reveals her secret; the sisters finally confront Tamar about her divorce and when past issues resurface, Tamar storms out.
Traci performs at Toni's show; Trina's new man meets Daddy; Traci confronts her son and his fiancée; Tamar throws a party.

Toni's back in the studio with beau, Birdman; when Miss Evelyn speaks to the press about Tamar's volatile relationship with Vince, Tamar goes into hiding; Trina and Traci's epic party bus to Las Vegas is a fail when an unexpected visitor arrives.
With Tamar in hiding, she may miss Toni's 50th birthday; Toni is stunned by a shocking party foul; Traci pressures her son over baby news; Tamar performs; Toni receives the Soul Train Legend Award.
The sisters get competitive on "Family Feud"; Evelyn is shocked by Tamar's new video; Traci makes Kevin Jr. and his fiancée care for a fake baby; Trina goes bar hopping.

Tamar is concerned that Trina's boyfriend wants a private meeting with their father; Towanda shocks everyone with her role in a theater project; Trina hosts a test run for Bar Chix; a bartender blows up.

Towanda's decision to take legal action could tear the Braxton family apart; Toni makes a shocking announcement; Towanda's ex blasts her on social media; Traci fears son Kevin is not ready to be a father and puts him in baby boot camp.
Trina's relationship takes a major turn; Tamar's ambitious photo shoot; Toni's Christmas album with the sisters.

Toni shoots her music video; Traci gets snubbed by Tamar on her movie set, and, when the sisters find out, they're taken aback; the sisters have bad news for Toni; Trina buys a pricey item; Tamar helps plan Mommy's birthday, but she may not show up.
The sisters work on Toni's Christmas album; Traci storms out over drama; Jacent's gift thrills Trina; Tamar's album.

The sisters are stunned when an unexpected guest shows up at Mommy's birthday party; Toni invites the girls on the set of her movie, and they're shocked by her transformation; Traci reveals the gender of her grandbaby.

Toni finally shares she's engaged with the sisters, but it quickly escalates into sibling rivalry over who's planning the wedding; Traci starts to plan her son's baby shower, but fears the worst when her father asks for an invitation for his wife.
Evelyn suffers from a stroke; East Coast vs. West Coast sister battle over Mommy; Traci faces a health scare.

Tamar and Towanda take over Toni's wedding planning; Traci celebrates her son's baby shower, but her joy is cut short when she receives devastating news about her upcoming tour with her sisters and fears they are to blame.
Trina hires a matchmaker for Mommy in Atlanta; Toni craves new experience; Tamar wants the Hollywood Medium to help her reconnect with angels.
Toni's wedding is in jeopardy; the sisters confront Traci about facing her unresolved issues; a family rift turns into an avalanche of emotions; the Braxtons shock all with a dramatic turn of events.
Tamar opens up about being fired from "The Real"; Trina suspects she has a stalker; Miss E's date is crashed by Tamar & Toni.
Family tension rises; Toni demands an apology; the Braxton sisters shock all by refusing to show up for work; all communication stops and production shuts down, putting the show's future in jeopardy.
Towanda spills the tea about Trina's man; Traci worries about her surgery; Tamar gets upset when Towanda goes missing at her fashion show.
The sisters' shocking walkout changes everything; Traci makes a difficult decision; talks with the Braxtons about returning to the show reach a pivotal moment; celebrity friends rally around Traci.
Toni screens her biopic movie; Tamar meets her on-screen counterpart; Towanda reveals her secret to Trina.

Phaedra Parks, Luenell, Natalie Nunn, and other celebrity friends join Traci for an outrageous wellness retreat; Traci is pressed for Braxton gossip; a drastic turn of events concerning the sisters changes everything.
Toni performs in Brooklyn; Towanda's partner disappoints; Tamar critiques Towanda; Toni tells Tamar her plans to change her show.

Toni faces Traci about the divided sisterhood; Towanda speaks out; Traci escapes family drama at a dude ranch where she is joined by outrageous reality stars; in a crazy turn of events, Flavor Flav and New York reunite to turn the rodeo upside down.
Tamar performs for Smokey Robinson; Toni has a date; Towanda's secret appointment; Trina confronts her sisters.

Toni is shocked when Trina and Towanda reveal the truth about Traci's role in the strike; Tamar speaks out on family drama; Towanda hatches a plan to heal the sisterhood; Traci returns from the cattle drive and must perform amidst tense sister drama.
Trina shocks all when she reaches out to her ex, Gabe; Tamar disapproves; Toni has the takeover spirit in a sister cook off.

After years of broken communication, the Braxtons begin explosive family therapy with Iyanla Vanzant to heal the fractured sisterhood; when things take an unexpected turn, Iyanla calls them out, and it leads to a shocking exit.
Trina has a candid convo with her ex, Gabe; emotions run high at Toni's final show with Trina and Towanda as the background singers.

The Braxtons reveal shocking and surprising confessions to Iyanla Vanzant to heal the broken sisterhood -- including one sister's admission she doesn't like her sisters and another's tearful apology; when pushed too far, Tamar storms off.
Toni celebrates her sisters' final performance with a surprise visitor; Toni invites a man to dinner; Tamar coaches mommy for her runway debut.

After an emotional family healing retreat, the Braxtons work to repair their fractured sisterhood; Tamar presses Toni for answers about Birdman; Tamar finds new love and is on the road with Snoop; the sisters reunite, but Toni storms out.
Trina continues to move forward with Gabe; Tamar's photo shoot; Traci records a new, sexy album but her manager has doubts.

Tamar's celebratory dinner is interrupted when Toni reveals the truth about why she stormed out; Tamar reveals her mystery man; Toni is crowned a Lady; Trina meets Von's mom, but is grilled about her past.
Gabe comes clean to Trina in a shocking admission; Tamar performs at an exclusive event; Traci tricks her sisters; Toni's dinner is ruined.

Tamar embarks on a secret spy mission to uncover her sisters' secrets; after mounting tension, Traci and Tamar team up to plan Trina's birthday; a family celebration takes a shocking turn when devastating news rocks the sisterhood.
Tamar has a big surprise for the sisters; Trina worries about Towanda's move; Trina seeks a hypnotist.

Toni consoles Trina after news of Gabe's illness; Trina is shocked by Toni's confession about Birdman; Traci joins Tamar's tour, and they try to put their differences aside, but a backstage fight erupts and threatens the sisters' new bond.
Trina's sons have a showdown with her ex, Gabe, and they don't hold back; Tamar breaks the news to producers that her sisters won't do the Broadway show; Towanda performs for an agent.

Tamar reveals big news; Toni makes headlines with shocking Birdman breakup rumors; Tamar and Traci meet face to face for the first time since their tour drama; a devastating tragedy strikes the sisterhood.
Tensions rise during a sister slumber party at Toni's house; a trip down memory lane opens old wounds; Tamar storms out.

Toni asks Trina and Towanda to perform with her unexpectedly, but Birdman shocks all and surprises Toni onstage; Tamar's new boo is interrogated by the sisters; the Braxtons are stunned by Tamar's "Celebrity Big Brother" breakdown.
